capstones.Challenge: Run a 12-week learning program in an unfamiliar field.
capstones.Required evidence: Delayed unseen test; teaching evidence; AI-use comparison

capstones.Challenge: Measure and explain a real local physical/biological/social system.
capstones.Required evidence: Field notebook; model; uncertainty; external check

capstones.Challenge: Read a major work and its historical/rival contexts; defend an original interpretation.
Design, build, test, repair, or materially improve a physical or software system.
capstones.Required evidence: Requirements; prototype; failure injection; maintenance plan

capstones.Challenge: Diagnose an organization/institution across rules, incentives, power, information, metrics, and history.
capstones.Required evidence: Evidence map; stakeholder challenge; reversible redesign

capstones.Challenge: Design and execute an evidence-informed personal health or life-operations improvement without medical overreach.
capstones.Required evidence: Baseline; safe plan; behavior evidence; limits/referral criteria

capstones.Challenge: Create a long-horizon household financial policy and stress-test it against realistic shocks.
capstones.Required evidence: Cash flow; risk; contracts; scenarios; scam/fee audit

capstones.Challenge: Explain one difficult technical/human problem to three audiences in three media.
capstones.Required evidence: Expert, public, youth versions + accuracy review

capstones.Challenge: Delegate a consequential multi-step project to agents under explicit permissions and adversarial evals.
capstones.Required evidence: Contract; provenance; hidden tests; incident response; no-AI defense

capstones.Challenge: Improve a small real institution or community process with consent and accountability.
Curate a corpus, articulate criteria, then create/revise an original work or design within a tradition.
capstones.Required evidence: Blind ranking; curatorial statement; artifact; critique response

capstones.Challenge: Integrate at least four trunks on an unresolved scientific/technological/civilizational problem.
capstones.Required evidence: Research dossier; prototype/model; ethics/governance; public defense
